title: Finite-triple comparisons transfer the Mittag-Leffler condition
statement: Let T and U be inverse systems of types indexed by the opposite natural numbers. Assume that for every pair of composable transition maps U_t → U_m → U_n there are bijections at levels t, m and n that commute with the map t → n and with the map m → n. If U satisfies the Mittag-Leffler condition, then T satisfies the Mittag-Leffler condition.

proof.text: Use the eventual-range characterization of Mittag-Leffler for U. Given an element in the range of T's stabilized map, transport it back along the bijection at the middle level, use U's range inclusion, and transport the resulting preimage forward along the bijection at the largest level. The two finite-triple commutation equations identify the resulting image with the original element.
